info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Goals API
info.description: Goals API lets you Manage existing goals, via "updateGoal" and "deleteGoal", create new Goals via "addGoal", or list existing Goals for one or several websites via "getGoals" If you are tracking Ecommerce orders and products on your site, the functions "getItemsSku", "getItemsName" and "getItemsCategory" will return the list of products purchased on your site, either grouped by Product SKU, Product Name or Product Category.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website to query.
(Required) The numeric ID of the goal to query.

response.name:
Goal attributes, or `null` if the goal does not exist.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website to configure the goal for.
(Required) Goal name.
(Required) Attribute used to match conversions.

(Required) Match pattern. Use a URL, title, filename, external website, or event value for string match attributes; use a numeric threshold for visit duration, actions, or pageview match attributes; this value is ignored for `manually`.
(Required) Matching operator. Numeric match attributes only accept `greater_than`; string match attributes accept `exact`, `contains`, or `regex`; use an empty string for `manually`.
Whether string matching should be case-sensitive.
Default revenue to assign to conversions. Pass `false` or `0` to disable a fixed revenue value.
Whether multiple conversions may be recorded within one visit.
Optional goal description shown in the Goals management UI.
Whether to use the tracked event value as goal revenue. This is only valid for event-based goals.

Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) Website ID(s) to query. - Single site ID (e.g. 1) - Multiple site IDs (e.g. [1, 4, 5]) - Comma-separated list ("1,4,5") or "all"
(Required) The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.
(Required) The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).
Whether to return abandoned-cart product metrics instead of purchased products.
Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.
